retreat: Be Still: Five Days with the Psalms of Trust
title: Be Still, and Know
grace: Ask for the grace to be still in the midst of upheaval, and to know that God is God, and that I do not have to be.
focus: Name the waters that are roaring in your life right now, and listen beneath them for the voice that says, "Be still."

retreat: Follow Me: Five Days with the First Disciples
title: Follow Me
grace: Ask for the grace to hear Jesus call me by name, and the freedom to leave what keeps me from following him.
focus: Stand on the shore with Simon and Andrew. Notice the nets in your own hands, and what it would mean to leave them immediately.

retreat: Passages for prayer: rest and return
title: While He Was Still Far Off
grace: Ask for the grace to know myself as the one the Father runs to meet.
focus: Walk home with the younger son, rehearsing your speech, and let the Father interrupt it.

title: She Turned and Said, Rabboni
grace: Ask for the grace to recognize the risen Lord when he calls me by name, in my grief.
focus: Stay with Mary at the empty tomb, weeping, and notice the moment you are called by name.

retreat: Be Still: Five Days with the Psalms of Trust
title: You Have Searched Me
grace: Ask for the grace to know that I am fully known and fully loved, and that there is nowhere I could go beyond God's reach.
focus: Bring God the place in you that feels darkest, and hear that even the darkness is not dark to him.

retreat: Blessed: Six Days with the Beatitudes
title: Blessed Are the Poor in Spirit
grace: Ask for the grace to receive the Beatitudes as blessing, not as a test I must pass.
focus: Sit on the mountainside among the crowd and notice which blessing seems spoken to you.
